extra.reason: Froze PlecSsrSnapshot v1 in crates/plec-ir: Rust-owned camelCase schema (route chain+params+phase, public exports reusing PublicExport/validate_public_export, loader outcomes derived from manifest entries, per-instance structural ownership with branch/loop node handles) plus fail-closed validate() against manifest+application. 30 tests incl. serde round-trip and one negative per rule; no TS schema added; doc pointer added to docs/ssr-architecture.md.

Adoption claims now resolve through one TypedAdoptionIndex per scope (TypedAdoptionScope::Element|Range), built in a single walk: element data-plec-node attributes and ownership comments share one map; repeated markers fail adoption with duplicate:ssr-marker:{marker} instead of last-wins; nested component adoptions claim the sibling range between their plec:component[-end] markers so they no longer re-walk the whole root; all missing:ssr-* / mismatch:ssr-tag codes unchanged. Verified: cargo lib tests 27 passed; wasm-bindgen suite 34 passed incl. 3 new adversarial-adoption tests (scoped-walk counter <45 vs >=45 full-root rewalk, duplicate marker, missing/mismatch codes) and the nested grandchild action/binding stays live on server DOM; apps/fullstack acceptance-adoption.mjs passed against rebuilt runtime wasm.

Server publishes matched params (RequestContext.params + snapshot chain, tested); browser gate validates the server-published chain via validateSsrRouteChain and no longer path-matches (route-mismatch retired for mismatch:ssr-route-chain:*); WASM cross-validates imported chain vs typed_route_chain in adopt_typed_route with fail-closed length/route/params/phase details; fixed two latent moq.2 blockers surfaced by the acceptance path: snapshot structure validation now resolves graph ids across all registered applications, and ssr_text_divergences is actually exported to JS. Audited against all five acceptance criteria; implementation complete, gaps resolved.

(2) Cookie fixture: loadHost('cookie') evaluates absent at the SSR render boundary; no cookie value in HTML or bootstrap (plec-server vitest 3/3); dev-only x-plec-ssr-gating header identifies cookie:<name>, absent in production. (4) x-plec-ssr-fallback-style dev observability shipped as x-plec-ssr-gating. (5) Negative tests both sides: server cookie-leak fixture + IR smuggled-export rejection. Loader state transfer complete: server executes route loaders via the compiled routeLoader action subset (static-URL GET + responseJson, packages/plec-server/src/index.ts executeRouteLoader), publishes resolved/rejected outcomes keyed by loader_ref(graph_id, action) in the v2 snapshot (phase active/error), and renders loaderData via the loadHost host slot plus the error graph for rejections. Browser resumes: adopt_typed_route seeds the loaderData host input before adoption and skips the initial run for resolved outcomes; rejected outcomes adopt the server-rendered error graph, restore the recorded error via set_route_error, and retry_typed_route re-enters the loader (unsupported:ssr-route-loader removed; ssr_route_chain_mismatch now enforces phase/outcome pairing and fails closed on missing/mispaired outcomes, including legacy adoption without a snapshot). Added typed_ssr_loaders store with abandon purge; fixed the no-pending-graph loader completion path to re-apply host inputs before the dependency refresh (crates/plec-runtime/src/typed/fetch.rs). Demo: simple /notes loader route (no conditionals/loops, adoptable ahead of moq.7/8) with /api/notes endpoint, nav link, router entry. Verification: plec-runtime 50 wasm + 29 lib tests (5 new loader-transfer tests covering resolved-skip, missing-outcome fail-closed, legacy fail-closed, rejected-restore+retry, fresh-nav-runs-loader), plec-server 5 tests + typecheck, plec-compiler 112 tests, plec-ir 30 tests, plec-browser 10 tests, fullstack 9 tests, acceptance-adoption (loader route adopted, request count == 0, payload on screen), acceptance-todos (SSR todos loader rendered server-side).
